title: Bulk scraping in web script bloats browser memory — use cookies + HTTP
symptom: While web script walks thousands of pages, browser_memory_exceeded appears, or browser_hung repeats before that and the computer slows down from swapping
cause: Every page opened inside the browser piles up renderers and cache. Measured: one snippet grew Chrome to 275 GB with 40 GB of swap. The browser is a login tool, not a scraping engine
fix: Use the browser only to log in, and have web script write context.cookies() to a file in the run folder (do not print it as the result — it would stay in the records)
Scrape over HTTP (urllib · requests) with those cookies in a Cookie header. If a list API exists, call the API instead of the screens
If it must run in the browser, split pages into batches of a few dozen, call web script several times, and close opened tabs with page.close()
The limit is web script --memory-limit-mb or PRO_LAUNCH_BROWSER_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB (default 32768). Going over kills the browser, so start it again with web open
